checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["boombox","boom","box","multi"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()
